title: Sources: Kalshi bought FB Securities, a small New York-based broker, in July and plans to launch equity trading within the next two months (Vicky Ge Huang/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Vicky Ge Huang / Wall Street Journal: Sources: Kalshi bought FB Securities, a small New York-based broker, in July and plans to launch equity trading within the next two months — The prediction-markets platform, still fighting legal battles with U.S. states over its yes-or-no contracts, wants to expand into other assets
